source_audit.source_name: Designated and Calendared Buildings and Sites
source_audit.publisher: New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) via NYC Open Data
source_audit.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use; dataset page did not expose a specific license value in Socrata metadata
source_audit.coverage_note: Queried records with desdate from 2008-01-01 through 2026-12-31, most_curre=1, status=DESIGNATED, and lm_type in Individual Landmark, Interior Landmark, and Scenic Landmark. Rows were collapsed by LP number because multi-building or multi-lot landmarks can have more than one point row.
source_audit.limitations: This source records LPC administrative preservation status and point locations for regulated items. It does not document construction, completion, physical alteration, public access, repair status, or preservation outcome effects. Some coordinates are representative points and multi-lot landmarks can have multiple rows.

source_audit.publisher: New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) via NYC Open Data
source_audit.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use; dataset page did not expose a specific license value in Socrata metadata
source_audit.coverage_note: Reviewed as an official LPC source family for individual landmark site geometry. The SODA resource returned empty objects in this environment, so candidate extraction used the newer Designated and Calendared Buildings and Sites dataset for record-level fields.
source_audit.limitations: Useful as a map/source-family cross-check, but not used as the primary row source here because record fields were not exposed through the tested SODA JSON endpoint.

source_audit.publisher: New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC) via NYC Open Data
source_audit.license: NYC Open Data Terms of Use; dataset page did not expose a specific license value in Socrata metadata
source_audit.coverage_note: Reviewed for historic-district source-family coverage. Most post-2008 historic-district LP numbers already appear in the seed file, so this round emphasized additional individual, interior, and scenic landmark records.
source_audit.limitations: Historic district geometry is boundary-based, but this batch does not add new district candidates because the obvious official district designations were already represented in the seed or earlier rounds.

source_audit.publisher: New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission (LPC)
source_audit.license: NYC website terms; factual metadata and source URLs only
source_audit.coverage_note: Useful for later enrichment of descriptions and boundaries by LP number. Not scraped in this round; source URLs below use the Open Data row endpoint for parseable provenance.
source_audit.limitations: Designation-report PDFs may contain richer historical narratives and boundary text, but reuse terms and PDF extraction should be reviewed before importing larger text excerpts.
